svg.title: Annual CPA Cohort: Eligible Traffic to Payable Depositor
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-02-eligible-affiliate-cohort; chart type: funnel; title: Annual CPA Cohort: Eligible Traffic to Payable Depositor; subtitle: Five nested counts describe the affiliate lane only.; chapter number: 6; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: Illustrative annual unique-visitor cohort underlying the Base-Case $90,000 CPA revenue allocation. Counts are nested, deduplicated, and measured within contract-specific attribution windows. Terminal subscribers and NGR-only partners are outside this funnel. Entry screening is not a substitute for the operator's age and identity checks.; caption: 50,000 eligible visitors produce 100 payable FTD events at $900 each; a 120-event full-budget planning baseline is reduced by 20 events for seasonal CPA availability before revenue is booked.; stages: label: Eligible adult visitor cohort; value: 50,000 screened unique visitors; numeric value: 50000.0; detail: Start with unique visitors passing first-party 21+ screening and permitted-location checks. Preserve jurisdiction, campaign, and partner eligibility evidence while minimizing personal data. Exclude blocked locations and ineligible destinations before commercial links become available.; label: Qualified comparison cohort; value: 15,000 visitors; 30% of entry cohort; numeric value: 15000.0; detail: Count visitors who use a comparison page for an eligible licensed partner and see current commercial terms and the affiliate disclosure. Remove automated traffic and duplicate identities under the documented attribution policy.; label: Attributed click cohort; value: 3,000 visitors; 20% of comparison cohort; numeric value: 3000.0; detail: Create a signed click identifier and store the state, campaign, creative version, and partner offer version. A redirect is evidence of a click, not evidence of a deposit, account approval, or payable commission.; label: Partner-confirmed FTD cohort; value: 300 depositors; 10% of click cohort; numeric value: 300.0; detail: Accept first-time-depositor events only from authenticated partner reporting after operator checks. Match depositors to the originating cohort; deposits still may fail minimum amount, attribution-window, campaign-cap, or commission eligibility terms.; label: Contract-payable CPA cohort; value: 100 depositors; 33.33% of FTD cohort; numeric value: 100.0; detail: Reconcile all 300 events into 100 payable and 200 nonpayable outcomes with explicit partner reason codes. The 100 accepted events generate $90,000 at $900 each. Seasonality is already reflected in this count; do not subtract the $18,000 planning reduction again as operating expense.

text.title: Annual CPA Cohort: Eligible Traffic to Payable Depositor
text.tspan: Annual CPA Cohort: Eligible Traffic to Payable Depositor

rect.title: label: Eligible adult visitor cohort; value: 50,000 screened unique visitors; numeric value: 50000.0; detail: Start with unique visitors passing first-party 21+ screening and permitted-location checks. Preserve jurisdiction, campaign, and partner eligibility evidence while minimizing personal data. Exclude blocked locations and ineligible destinations before commercial links become available.

label: Qualified comparison cohort; value: 15,000 visitors; 30% of entry cohort; numeric value: 15000.0; detail: Count visitors who use a comparison page for an eligible licensed partner and see current commercial terms and the affiliate disclosure. Remove automated traffic and duplicate identities under the documented attribution policy.

label: Attributed click cohort; value: 3,000 visitors; 20% of comparison cohort; numeric value: 3000.0; detail: Create a signed click identifier and store the state, campaign, creative version, and partner offer version. A redirect is evidence of a click, not evidence of a deposit, account approval, or payable commission.

label: Partner-confirmed FTD cohort; value: 300 depositors; 10% of click cohort; numeric value: 300.0; detail: Accept first-time-depositor events only from authenticated partner reporting after operator checks. Match depositors to the originating cohort; deposits still may fail minimum amount, attribution-window, campaign-cap, or commission eligibility terms.

label: Contract-payable CPA cohort; value: 100 depositors; 33.33% of FTD cohort; numeric value: 100.0; detail: Reconcile all 300 events into 100 payable and 200 nonpayable outcomes with explicit partner reason codes. The 100 accepted events generate $90,000 at $900 each. Seasonality is already reflected in this count; do not subtract the $18,000 planning reduction again as operating expense.

text.title: Assumptions: Illustrative annual unique-visitor cohort underlying the Base-Case $90,000 CPA revenue allocation. Counts are nested, deduplicated, and measured within contract-specific attribution windows. Terminal subscribers and NGR-only partners are outside this funnel. Entry screening is not a substitute for the operator's age and identity checks.
